# VIM & VIGR

> > VIM & VIGR offers fashionable, graduated compression socks and wellness wear designed for everyday comfort, athletic recovery, and medical support across diverse styles and compression levels.

VIM & VIGR specializes in designer compression socks and leg wear featuring graduated compression technology in multiple mmHg levels (15-20, 20-30, 30-40), materials (nylon, cotton, merino wool), and styles for men, women, and specialized professions. Products are HSA/FSA eligible and FDA-registered for medical-grade compression support.

## Key Topics

- Graduated compression technology
- mmHg compression levels (15-20, 20-30, 30-40)
- Moisture-wicking nylon
- Merino wool compression
- Medical-grade compression
- Circulation support
- Athletic recovery
- Wide calf designs
- Open toe compression
- HSA/FSA eligible
- FDA-registered
- Compression leg sleeves
- Falling Stripe pattern
- Mod Rose pattern
- Pickle Paddle pattern
